cited.quote: The GST Council recommended to abolish the Compensation Cess on fulfilment of obligations

rationale: C2 covers GST compensation cess being abolished on Council recommendation, but no extract shows a state demand, resolution or letter seeking GST compensation. C3 is a revenue committee, not a demand. No official step for this commitment.

cited.quote: To enhance intellectual property generation, protection, and technology transfer to speed up commercialisation.

rationale: C2 lists a general IP objective of the Deep Tech Startup Policy. No extract shows an IP Protection Fund for Tamil digital creators or any GO, sanction or scheme for it.

The scheme the promise refers to is not identified, and no extract shows a Rs. 50 lakh incentive award for schools excelling in learning outcomes. Extracts cover sports incentives and student scholarships only.

cited.quote: The Government envisioned to establish retail outlets for the sale of fish and fishery products across the State.

rationale: C2 states intent to establish retail outlets for fish and notes TNFDC's existing 39 outlets, but gives no GO, sanction or tender for new separate outlets. Statement of intent only.

cited.quote: Participating in international exhibitions and trade fairs
renovating and enhancing its sales outlets and creating new showrooms

rationale: C2 and C5 describe ongoing handloom and handicraft activities. No extract shows the Rs.400 crore allocation, a powerloom workshop, Sungudi export marketing or a new sales centre GO. Only general continuing activity.
No extract is about a monthly Rs.2500 assistance to unemployed youth. C1 covers loan and subsidy schemes for entrepreneurs (NEEDS, UYEGP), which are different in kind.

cited.quote: function under the direct contro! of the Honorable Chief Minister
will operate under the direct supervision of the Hon’ble Chief Minister

rationale: C1, G.O.(Ms) No.49 dated 2026-08-08, sanctions the Anti-Narcotics Task Force units and posts and places them under the direct control of the Chief Minister. C3 confirms. An earlier GO of 10.05.2026 is only mentioned in C4 without its terms, so the dated GO in C1 is used.

cited.quote: announced a Sugarcane Special Incentive of Rs.709.50/- per tonne for the 2025–26 crushing Season

rationale: C1 reports a Chief Minister announcement of a special incentive giving a total cane price of Rs.4,000 per tonne, below the Rs.4,500 promised, and shows no GO or operational step. The price is stated as what farmers will receive. No official step at the promised amount.
No extract mentions a Global Investors Meet held or planned in Coimbatore, Madurai, Trichy or Salem. C1 refers only generally to investor delegations, roadshows and global summits.

cited.quote: Washing Allowance – Rs.500 per month These allowances are provided to personnel

rationale: C5 shows a Rs.500 washing allowance for prison personnel, a different group, and no extract shows a police washing allowance raised to Rs.1000. C2 covers printing workers. No official step for police.

cited.quote: a Legal Assistance Center was established through the Commissionerate of Rehabilitation and Welfare of Non-Resident Tamils

rationale: C1 and C2 describe non-resident Tamil welfare (helpline, legal aid cell) but no extract shows a Property Protection Tribunal, a bill or a GO to establish one. Legal aid for Tamils abroad is a different object.

cited.quote: Priority will be given to the construction, reconstruction, renovation, and upgradation of the following assets based on need and condition

rationale: C1 and C2 describe TN-VETRI sub-missions in future terms (priority will be given, will support) for community assets, street lights and village forests. No GO or launch is shown. C3 and C5 are a Union employment scheme notification, not this commitment.

cited.quote: The Heritage Wing is entrusted with the conservation, renovation and restoration of heritage buildings.

rationale: C1 and C2 show the PWD renovating government heritage buildings. No extract shows a 50 percent incentive for those who renovate heritage buildings at their own cost, or any GO for it.

cited.quote: engages temporary teachers through School Management Committees (SMCs) wherever required

rationale: C1 only shows temporary teachers continuing to be engaged through SMCs. No extract shows any measure for equal pay with permanent teachers. Directional commitment: continuing activity with no new step is not_started.

The hostels in question are not identified and no extract mentions a Rs.2500 monthly maximum fee. C2, C3 and C4 describe food charges and facilities in welfare hostels, which are not about this fee cap.

cited.quote: During the year 2025–26, 9.59 lakh beneficiaries were given financial assistance, with an expenditure of Rs.1,158.47 crore.

rationale: C2 shows an existing instalment-based maternity assistance totalling Rs.18,000 and nutrition kits, which pre-date this government and are not the Rs.25,000 assistance. No extract shows a new Rs.25,000 scheme or GO.

cited.quote: SIPCOT is now transitioning from conventional industrial estate development towards next-generation industrial ecosystems

rationale: C1 and C2 describe SIPCOT's general activities and sector parks. C4 plans new parks in backward districts. No extract shows a GO or sanction for comprehensive modernisation of all existing SIPCOT parks.

cited.quote: Ranipet has established itself as a vibrant leather manufacturing hub

rationale: C1 describes the Ranipet leather cluster as it exists. No extract shows a Rs.500 crore allocation or any GO for upgrading leather tanning in Tirupathur, Vellore and Ranipet.

cited.quote: The existing loads in the overloaded feeders will be bifurcated to ensure reliable and uninterrupted power

rationale: C1 states future plans (will be bifurcated) for reliable supply. No extract shows an order to ensure 24-hour uninterrupted supply across the state. Policy note intent is not an official step.

cited.quote: enabling TNPDCL to ensure a reliable and uninterrupted power supply to the consumers

rationale: C1 and C2 are parts of the Energy Department policy note, which lists Vision 2031 plans and a study in design, not a separate policy document on uninterrupted supply. The phrasing is of intent and ongoing activity, so no official step is shown.
